plan: General 8 Semester Plan, No Threads, AY 2025-26 (College of Computing credit sheet)
subject: ENGL
title: English Composition I
notes: Sheet: 'ENGL 1101 Engl Comp I'.
description: A composition course focusing on skills required for effective writing in a variety of contexts, with emphasis on exposition, analysis, and argumentation, and also including introductory use of a variety of research skills. title: Differential Calculus

subject: ENGL

notes: Sheet: 'ENGL 1102 Engl Comp II'.
description: A composition course that develops writing skills beyond the levels of proficiency required by ENGL 1101, that emphasizes interpretation and evaluation, and that incorporates a variety of more advanced research methods.
